meta.method: MediaWiki API action=parse rendered HTML; class progression tables parsed programmatically, feature text summarised from each feature page

barbarian.progression_notes: rage_damage is the flat bonus while raging (+2, +3 from barbarian level 9). rage_charges recharge on long rest.

features.name: Rage
features.effect: Bonus action + 1 Rage Charge, 10 turns. Deal +2 extra damage (+3 at level 9) with melee and improvised weapons, unarmed strikes and thrown objects; resistance to physical damage; Advantage on Strength checks and saves. Unlike 5e it also applies to finesse/Dexterity melee attacks. Can't cast or concentrate on spells. Heavy armour imposes Rage Impeded (no extra damage/resistance). Ends early if you neither attack an enemy nor take damage in a turn.

features.name: Reckless Attack
features.effect: Melee weapon attack (or a free post-strike reaction on a miss, reroll). Until your next turn you have Advantage on melee and throwing attack rolls; enemies have Advantage on attacks against you.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.effect: Make an additional free attack after making an unarmed or weapon attack with an Action. Does not stack with other Extra Attack sources (except Warlock Deepened Pact outside Honour mode).

features.name: Feral Instinct
features.effect: +3 to Initiative and can't be Surprised.

features.name: Brutal Critical
features.effect: On a critical hit roll one extra weapon damage die (one die only, e.g. +1d6 for a greatsword, +1d12 for a greataxe). Only main-hand melee weapon attacks or unarmed melee attacks.

features.name: Relentless Rage
features.effect: Once per short rest, dropping to 0 HP while Enraged leaves you at 1 HP instead.

features.name: Frenzy
features.effect: Replaces Rage (same +2/+3 damage, resistance, Advantage on STR). While Frenzied you gain Frenzied Strike and Enraged Throw and can make an Improvised Melee Weapon attack as a bonus action.

features.name: Frenzied Strike
features.effect: While Enraged: bonus action melee weapon attack, once per turn. Each use adds a stack of Frenzied Strain (-1 to attack rolls per stack until Frenzy ends); bug: no Strain is applied from barbarian level 9.

features.name: Enraged Throw
features.effect: While Frenzied: bonus action, throw an item or creature (range 18 m), additional damage based on Strength, knocks the target Prone (no save). Thrown weapons deal their melee damage.

features.name: Mindless Rage
features.effect: While Frenzied, can't be Charmed or Frightened; Calm Emotions no longer ends rage.

features.name: Intimidating Presence
features.effect: Action: Frighten an enemy; can be maintained.

features.name: Giant's Rage
features.effect: Replaces Rage: enter Rage and increase in size. Rage damage bonus +2 (+3 at barbarian level 9) for weapon/unarmed attacks, and doubled for throw attacks: +4 (+6 at level 9).

features.name: Thaumaturgy
features.effect: Free cantrip (Advantage on Intimidation and Performance).

features.name: Boot of the Giants
features.effect: Bonus action kick that pushes a target away (Athletics based); works like a Shove that also deals damage.
features.unverified_reason: damage amount of the kick not stated on the pages read

features.name: Elemental Cleaver
features.effect: While Enraged (no action cost): your weapon deals 1d6 additional Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder damage until rage ends and gains the Thrown property (returns to hand). Stacks with Elemental Weapon. Extra elemental damage on a thrown cleaver weapon is non-magical.

features.name: Mighty Impel
features.effect: While Enraged, bonus action: throw a Medium or smaller creature or object 9 m; heavier creatures deal more damage.

features.name: Rage: Wild Magic
features.effect: Rage that also triggers a random Wild Magic effect: Bolt of Light (bonus action each turn, 1d6 Radiant + Blind on failed DC 12 CON), Dark Tendrils (1d12 Necrotic to each creature within 9 m on failed DC 12 CON, you gain 1d12 temp HP), Intangible Spirit (bonus action flumph, 1d6 Force within 4.5 m on failed DEX), Magic Retribution (attackers that hit you take 1d6 Force), Protective Lights (+1 AC to you and allies within 3 m), Teleport (bonus action 18 m), Vine Growth (difficult terrain), Weapon Infusion (weapon deals +1d6 Force and gains Light and Thrown).

features.name: Magic Awareness
features.effect: Allies within range add 1d4 to saving throws (short rest).

features.name: Bolstering Magic: Boon
features.effect: You or an ally gain +1d4 to attack rolls and ability checks for 10 turns (long rest). Separate once-per-long-rest options recover a level 1 or level 2 spell slot (level 3 slot from level 9).

features.name: Unstable Backlash
features.effect: While raging, when you take damage or fail a save, trigger another Wild Magic effect (replaces the current one).

features.name: Rage: Bear Heart
features.effect: Rage (+2/+3 damage) with Resistance to all damage except Psychic (resistance not impeded by heavy armour); grants Unrelenting Ferocity (action, heal 1d8 + CON once per rage).

features.name: Rage: Eagle Heart
features.effect: Rage; grants Diving Strike (action, leap onto a foe at least 1.5 m below: normal weapon damage + Prone, no fall damage); Disadvantage on opportunity attacks against you; Dash as a bonus action.

features.name: Rage: Elk Heart
features.effect: Rage; +4.5 m movement; grants Primal Stampede (action + movement, 9 m line, 1d4 + STR Bludgeoning to every non-ally in the path, Prone on failed STR save DC 10 + STR mod; triggers Extra Attack).

features.name: Rage: Tiger Heart
features.effect: Rage (+2/+3 damage); jump distance +4.5 m; grants Tiger's Bloodlust (action: attack up to 3 enemies in a 2 m cone for half normal weapon damage each and Bleeding: 2 Slashing per turn for 2 turns, no save; Rage and GWM bonuses are not halved).

features.name: Rage: Wolf Heart
features.effect: Rage (+2/+3 damage); allies have Advantage on melee attack rolls against enemies within 2 m of you (not the barbarian itself); grants Inciting Howl (allies +3 m movement).

features.name: Aspect of the Beast: Tiger
features.effect: Animal Aspect option: add your Strength modifier an additional time to attack rolls against Bleeding or Poisoned targets (applies twice if both); Survival proficiency.

features.name: Aspect of the Beast: Wolverine
features.effect: Animal Aspect option: attacking a Bleeding or Poisoned target inflicts Maimed.

features.name: Additional Animal Aspect
features.effect: Choose a second Animal Aspect.

bard.extra_attack_note: College of Swords and College of Valour gain Extra Attack at bard level 6.
bard.progression_notes: bardic_inspirations recharge on long rest, and also on short rest from level 5 (Font of Inspiration).

features.name: Bardic Inspiration
features.effect: Bonus action + 1 Bardic Inspiration: an ally within 18 m adds 1d6 (1d8 at bard level 5, 1d10 at 10) to its next attack roll, ability check or saving throw.

features.name: Font of Inspiration
features.effect: Regain all Bardic Inspirations on a short or long rest.

features.name: Magical Secrets
features.effect: Learn 2 non-Bard spells from a restricted Magical Secrets list (e.g. Hunter's Mark, Eldritch Blast, Hex are on it).

features.name: Mantle of Inspiration
features.effect: Bonus action + Bardic Inspiration: 2 allies (3 at level 6, 4 at level 10) gain 5 temp HP (8 at 6, 11 at 10); melee attackers that hit them become Charmed. No direct damage.

features.name: Mantle of Majesty: Command
features.effect: Command a creature; Charmed targets automatically fail the save (long rest).

features.name: Cutting Words
features.effect: Reaction + Bardic Inspiration: target gets -1d6 (-1d8 at 5, -1d10 at 10) on an attack roll, ability check or saving throw. Unlike 5e it cannot reduce damage rolls.

features.name: Magical Secrets
features.effect: Learn 2 non-Bard spells of level 3 or lower from the Magical Secrets list.

features.name: Slashing Flourish (Melee)
features.effect: Action, Bardic Inspiration spent on hit: attack up to 2 enemies in a 2 m cone (separate attack rolls), normal weapon damage + 1d6 (1d8 at bard 5, 1d10 at 10). Ranged version: two attacks, can be the same target. Not limited to once per turn.

features.name: Defensive Flourish (Melee)
features.effect: Action, Bardic Inspiration spent on hit: normal weapon damage + 1d6/1d8/1d10 and +4 AC for 1 turn.

features.name: Mobile Flourish (Melee)
features.effect: Action, Bardic Inspiration spent on hit: normal weapon damage + 1d6/1d8/1d10, push 6 m, can teleport to the target.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.effect: Choose Duelling or Two-Weapon Fighting.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.effect: One additional attack after an Action attack.

features.name: Combat Inspiration
features.effect: Bonus action + Bardic Inspiration: ally adds 1d6 (1d8 at 5, 1d10 at 10) to its next attack roll, ability check, save, weapon damage roll, or AC against one attack. Also Medium Armour, Shields, Martial weapons proficiency.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.effect: One additional attack after an Action attack.

cleric.progression_notes: Channel Divinity charges recharge on short or long rest (1 from level 2, 2 from level 6).

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.effect: 1 charge at level 2, 2 at level 6, short rest. Turn Undead plus a domain action.

features.name: Destroy Undead
features.effect: Successfully Turned undead also take 4d6 Radiant (non-scaling).

features.name: Divine Intervention
features.effect: Once per playthrough; Sunder the Heretical deals a large amount of Radiant damage to all enemies nearby.
features.unverified_reason: Sunder the Heretical damage dice not read

features.name: Reaper
features.effect: Necromancy cantrips that target one creature (Bone Chill, Bursting Sinew, Toll the Dead) can target an additional creature. Martial weapon proficiency. Domain cantrip choice: Bone Chill, Bursting Sinew or Toll the Dead.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Touch of Death
features.effect: When you hit with a melee attack (including melee spell attacks), spend a Channel Divinity charge to deal 5 + 2 x cleric level Necrotic.

features.name: Inescapable Destruction
features.effect: All Necrotic damage you deal ignores Necrotic resistance.

features.name: Divine Strike: Necrotic
features.effect: Once per turn (as an attack action or free post-strike reaction), a weapon hit deals +1d8 Necrotic. Works with melee and ranged weapons in BG3 (not unarmed or thrown). Bug: the action and reaction versions have separate cooldowns, so it can apply twice per turn.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.effect: Add WIS modifier to damage of Cleric cantrips (Produce Flame, Sacred Flame, Bursting Sinew, Toll the Dead).

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.effect: Healing spells heal an additional 2 + spell level. Heavy Armour proficiency.

features.name: Divine Strike: Radiant
features.effect: Once per turn (as an attack action or free post-strike reaction), a weapon hit deals +1d8 Radiant. Works with melee and ranged weapons in BG3 (not unarmed or thrown). Bug: the action and reaction versions have separate cooldowns, so it can apply twice per turn.

features.name: Radiance of the Dawn
features.effect: Action + Channel Divinity: 2d10 + character level Radiant to enemies within 9 m, CON save for half.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.effect: Add WIS modifier to damage of Cleric cantrips (Produce Flame, Sacred Flame, Bursting Sinew, Toll the Dead).

features.name: Acolyte of Nature
features.effect: Learn a Druid cantrip (Poison Spray, Produce Flame, Shillelagh, Thorn Whip options). Heavy Armour proficiency.

features.name: Divine Strike: Elemental Fury
features.effect: Once per turn (as an attack action or free post-strike reaction), a weapon hit deals +1d8 Cold, Fire or Lightning (choice). Works with melee and ranged weapons in BG3 (not unarmed or thrown). Bug: the action and reaction versions have separate cooldowns, so it can apply twice per turn.

features.name: Wrath of the Storm
features.effect: Reaction when a nearby enemy attacks you: 2d8 Lightning or Thunder, save for half. Unlimited uses in BG3. Heavy Armour and Martial weapon proficiency.

features.name: Destructive Wrath
features.effect: Channel Divinity: when you roll Thunder or Lightning damage, deal maximum damage instead (only actions flagged with that damage type; prompt comes before the attack roll).

features.name: Thunderbolt Strike
features.effect: Thunder or Lightning damage pushes Large or smaller creatures 3 m.

features.name: Divine Strike: Thunder
features.effect: Once per turn (as an attack action or free post-strike reaction), a weapon hit deals +1d8 Thunder. Works with melee and ranged weapons in BG3 (not unarmed or thrown). Bug: the action and reaction versions have separate cooldowns, so it can apply twice per turn.

features.name: Invoke Duplicity
features.effect: Action + Channel Divinity, concentration, 10 turns: an illusion; you and allies have Advantage on attack rolls when both attacker and target are within 3 m of it.

features.name: Divine Strike: Poison
features.effect: Once per turn (as an attack action or free post-strike reaction), a weapon hit deals +1d8 Poison. Works with melee and ranged weapons in BG3 (not unarmed or thrown). Bug: the action and reaction versions have separate cooldowns, so it can apply twice per turn.

features.name: War Priest
features.effect: After an unarmed or weapon attack, spend a War Priest Charge to make an additional attack as a Bonus Action. Charges: 3 at cleric level 1, 4 at 5, 5 at 8, 6 at 11 (long rest). Heavy Armour and Martial weapon proficiency.

features.name: Guided Strike
features.effect: Channel Divinity (reaction): +10 to an attack roll.

features.name: War God's Blessing
features.effect: Channel Divinity reaction: +10 to an ally's attack roll.

features.name: Divine Strike: Weapon
features.effect: Once per turn (as an attack action or free post-strike reaction), a weapon hit deals +1d8 damage of the main-hand weapon's type. Works with melee and ranged weapons in BG3 (not unarmed or thrown). Bug: the action and reaction versions have separate cooldowns, so it can apply twice per turn.

druid.extra_attack_note: Wild Strike (level 5) and Improved Wild Strike (level 10) give 1 and 2 extra attacks, but only while in an animal Wild Shape.
druid.progression_notes: wild_shape_charges: 2 from level 2, never increases, recharge on short or long rest (Wild Shape Charge page).

features.name: Wild Shape
features.effect: Action + Wild Shape Charge (bonus action for Moon). Take on a beast's STR/DEX/CON, HP and AC. Beast attack damage dice gain extra damage at druid level 4 (1d4 or 1d6 depending on attack) and that die grows one size at levels 8 and 12 (Wild Shape Improvement). Special attack DC 8 + proficiency + WIS.

features.name: Wild Strike
features.effect: One additional attack roll after an Unarmed Strike (in practice any attack-roll Wild Shape action) while in an animal Wild Shape (not Starry Form, not Symbiotic Entity).

features.name: Improved Wild Strike
features.effect: Two additional attack rolls after an Unarmed Strike while in an animal Wild Shape.

features.name: Natural Recovery
features.effect: Out of combat, restore spell slots; charges = combined slot levels (1 at 2, 2 at 3, 3 at 5, 4 at 7, 5 at 9, 6 at 11), long rest. Bonus cantrip. Circle spells by land type at 3/5/7/9 (e.g. Mountain: Lightning Bolt; Arctic: Cone of Cold).

features.name: Combat Wild Shape
features.effect: Wild Shape as a bonus action; extra forms Bear (2), Dire Raven (4), Sabre-Toothed Tiger (8), Air/Earth/Fire/Water Myrmidons (10, cost 2 Wild Shape charges).

features.name: Primal Strike
features.effect: Beast-form attacks count as magical for overcoming resistance/immunity.

features.name: Halo of Spores
features.effect: Reaction, 6 m: 1d4 Necrotic (1d6 at level 6, 1d8 at level 10), CON save.

features.name: Symbiotic Entity
features.effect: Action + Wild Shape Charge: 4 temp HP per druid level; while you have them, weapon or unarmed attacks deal +1d6 Necrotic (ranged too, per bugs note) and Halo of Spores deals double damage. Does not count as Wild Shape for Wild Strike.

features.name: Spreading Spores
features.effect: Area that deals 2d8 Necrotic per turn to creatures inhaling it (not allies).

features.name: Starry Form: Archer
features.effect: Bonus action + Wild Shape Charge, until long rest. Each turn, bonus action Luminous Arrow: spell attack, 1d8 + spellcasting modifier Radiant (2d8 + mod from level 10). Bug: uses the spellcasting modifier of the most recent spellcasting class.

features.name: Starry Form: Dragon
features.effect: Concentration save rolls of 9 or lower count as 10. Bonus action Dazzling Breath: 5 m cone, 2d6 + spellcasting modifier Radiant (3d6 at 5, 4d6 at 10), DEX save for half, DC 8 + CON modifier + proficiency. Hover/fly at level 10.

features.name: Star Map: Guiding Bolt
features.effect: Cast Guiding Bolt without a spell slot using Star Maps (2 at level 2, 3 at 5, 4 at 9, long rest). Guidance cantrip.

features.name: Cosmic Omen
features.effect: Weal: +1d6 to an attack roll or save (or ally ability check); Woe: -1d6 to an attack roll or save. 3 uses (4 at level 9), long rest.

features.name: Twinkling Constellations
features.effect: Switch Starry Form once per turn as a free action; Luminous Arrow 2d8 + mod, Dazzling Breath 4d6 + mod.

fighter.spellcasting_note: Eldritch Knight subclass is a one-third caster using Intelligence.

features.name: Action Surge
features.effect: Free: gain an extra Action this turn (short rest). Attacks from the surged action also trigger Extra Attack.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.effect: One additional attack after an Action attack.

features.name: Improved Extra Attack
features.effect: Two additional attacks after an Action attack (3 attacks per Attack action).

features.name: Arcane Shots
features.effect: Action + Arcane Arrow (4 at level 3, 7 at 7, 10 at 10; short rest). Save DC 8 + proficiency + INT. Options: Banishing Arrow (normal damage, Banished, CHA save); Beguiling Arrow (+2d6 Psychic, Charmed, WIS); Bursting Arrow (+2d6 Force in 5 m radius, no save, refunded on miss); Enfeebling Arrow (+2d6 Necrotic, Feeble, CON); Grasping Arrow (+2d6 Poison, +2d6 Slashing per turn when moving, STR); Piercing Arrow (10 m line, DEX save, normal damage + 1d6 weapon type, half on save, works with Extra Attack); Seeking Arrow (always hits, +1d6 Force, Faerie Fire on failed DEX); Shadow Arrow (+2d6 Psychic, Blinded, WIS). Bug: the arcane shot bonus damage is not doubled on critical hits.

features.name: Curving Shot
features.effect: Once per turn, when a magical ranged attack misses, bonus action to repeat the same attack against the enemy closest to the original target.

features.name: Magic Arrow
features.effect: All ranged attacks count as magical for overcoming resistance.

features.name: Superiority Dice
features.effect: 4 d8 Superiority Dice at level 3, 5 at level 7, d10 from level 10 (Improved Combat Superiority). Recharge short rest. Manoeuvre save DC 8 + proficiency + higher of STR/DEX.

features.name: Manoeuvres
features.effect: Choose 3 (+2 at 7, +2 at 10). Attack manoeuvres (Action, weapon attack): Disarming, Distracting (allies get Advantage on next attack), Goading, Manoeuvring, Menacing, Pushing, Trip Attack: Normal weapon damage + Superiority Die (d8, d10 from level 10); die only spent on hit. Feinting Attack: Action + Bonus Action, attack with Advantage, + die. Precision Attack: add die to a weapon attack roll. Riposte: reaction when missed in melee, attack + die (spends die even on miss). Sweeping Attack: action, 2 m cone, deals only the Superiority Die (most bonuses don't apply). Commander's Strike, Evasive Footwork, Rally (8 temp HP). Manoeuvres cannot be used with bonus action attacks.

features.name: Improved Critical Hit
features.effect: Critical hit threshold reduced by 1 (crit on 19-20); stacks with other reductions.

features.name: Remarkable Athlete
features.effect: +3 m jump; half proficiency to non-proficient STR/DEX/CON checks.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.effect: Choose an additional fighting style.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.effect: One-third caster (Wizard list, mostly Abjuration/Evocation). Slots: L3 2x1st, L4 3x1st, L7 4x1st + 2x2nd, L10 4x1st + 3x2nd. Cantrips: 2, 3 from level 10.

features.name: War Magic
features.effect: After casting an Action cantrip, make a weapon attack as a Bonus Action (once per round; up to two attacks with multiple bonus actions). Does not trigger Extra Attack.

features.name: Eldritch Strike
features.effect: A weapon hit gives the target Disadvantage on its next save against your spell before the end of your next turn.

monk.progression_notes: ki_points = monk level + 1, recharge on short rest. martial_arts_die is the minimum damage die for monk weapons and unarmed strikes (1d4, 1d6 at 3, 1d8 at 9).

features.name: Martial Arts: Dextrous Attacks
features.effect: Monk weapons and unarmed attacks use DEX instead of STR if higher. Monk weapons = any proficient weapon without Two-Handed (Versatile counts).

features.name: Martial Arts: Deft Strikes
features.effect: Monk weapons and unarmed attacks deal 1d4 (1d6 at monk 3, 1d8 at monk 9) unless their normal damage is higher; keeps the weapon's damage type.

features.name: Martial Arts: Bonus Unarmed Strike
features.effect: After a melee monk-weapon or unarmed attack, make one unarmed attack as a Bonus Action. Also enabled by all Four Elements disciplines.

features.name: Flurry of Blows
features.effect: Bonus Action + 1 Ki: two unarmed strikes. Does not need a prior attack; does not trigger Extra Attack.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.effect: One additional attack after an Action attack.

features.name: Stunning Strike (Melee)
features.effect: Action, 1 Ki on hit: normal weapon (or unarmed) damage and Stun on failed CON save (DC 8 + proficiency + STR or DEX). Stunned: attack rolls against it have Advantage, auto-fail STR/DEX saves.

features.name: Ki-Empowered Strikes
features.effect: Unarmed attacks count as magical vs physical resistance/immunity.

features.name: Drunken Technique
features.effect: Replaces Flurry of Blows: Bonus Action + 1 Ki, two unarmed strikes, +3 m movement and Disengage.

features.name: Cheeky Tipple
features.effect: Immune to Drunk penalties; once per long rest drinking alcohol restores half your Ki (rounded down).

features.name: Intoxicating Strike
features.effect: Action (bonus action variant too) + 1 Ki: unarmed strike; on hit target may become Drunk (CON save) and you gain Life of the Party.

features.name: Life of the Party
features.effect: For 1 turn: +1 AC and + WIS modifier to attack rolls against Drunk targets.

features.name: Redirect Attack
features.effect: Reaction + 1 Ki when missed by a melee attack within 2 m: unarmed attack against the attacker.

features.name: Sobering Realisation
features.effect: Action + 1 Ki vs a Drunk target: unarmed damage + 2d8 + WIS modifier Psychic, removes Drunk and your Life of the Party. Bug: 1d8 in Honour mode.

features.name: Drunkard's Luck
features.effect: Spend 2 Ki to negate Disadvantage on an attack roll, ability check or save.

features.name: Elemental Disciplines
features.effect: Choose 3 (DC 8 + proficiency + WIS; not true spells, no metamagic/Spell Sniper). Damage (ki cost where the wiki lists it): Blade of Rime 2 ki 1d10 Piercing + 2d6 Cold; Chill of the Mountain 1d10 Cold; Fangs of the Fire Snake unarmed + 1d10 Fire, 6 m reach, next melee attacks +1d4 Fire, counts as unarmed attack (works with Extra Attack); Fist of Four Thunders 2 ki 2d8 Thunder; Fist of Unbroken Air 2 ki 3d10 Bludgeoning; Sphere of Elemental Balance 2 ki 3d8; Sweeping Cinder Strike 2 ki 3d6 Fire; Touch of the Storm 1d10 Lightning; Water Whip 2 ki 3d10 Bludgeoning. Level 6: Clench of the North Wind 3 ki, Embrace of the Inferno 3 ki 2d6 Fire per ray, Gong of the Summit 3 ki 3d8 Thunder. Level 11: Flames of the Phoenix 4 ki 8d6 Fire.
features.unverified_parts: Ki cost of Chill of the Mountain, Fangs of the Fire Snake, Touch of the Storm and Shaping of the Ice shown only as an icon (presumably 1); Sphere of Elemental Balance is 3d8 on the Elemental Disciplines page but 2d8 (3d8 thunder) on the Ki Point page.

features.name: Harmony of Fire and Water
features.effect: Out of combat, regain half your Ki (rounded down), long rest.

features.name: Improved Elemental Casting
features.effect: +1 damage die: Chill of the Mountain 2d10, Fist of Four Thunders 3d8, Fist of Unbroken Air 4d10, Gong of the Summit 4d8, Sweeping Cinder Strike 4d6, Touch of the Storm 2d10, Water Whip 4d10; Embrace of the Inferno +1 ray; Clench holds +1 creature.

features.name: Flurry of Blows: Topple
features.effect: Bonus Action + 1 Ki: two unarmed strikes; second hit forces DEX save (weapon action DC) or Prone. Variants: Stagger (no reactions), Push (5 m, STR save).

features.name: Manifestation of Body
features.effect: Toggle (one of Body/Mind/Soul active): unarmed attacks deal +1d4 + WIS modifier Necrotic (Mind: Psychic, Soul: Radiant).

features.name: Wholeness of Body
features.effect: Action, long rest: heal 3 x monk level, regain half Ki, then for 3 turns +1 Ki per turn and an extra Bonus Action (two Flurries per turn).

features.name: Ki Resonation: Blast
features.effect: 1 Ki, once per turn: detonate a Resonating creature (marked by Ki Resonation: Punch): 3d6 Force to it and non-party creatures within 5 m, DEX save half; chain reaction on other Resonating creatures.

features.name: Tranquillity
features.effect: Sanctuary after long rest until you attack.

features.name: Shadow Arts
features.effect: Spend 2 Ki for Darkness, Pass Without Trace, Darkvision, Silence; Shadow Arts: Hide as a bonus action; Minor Illusion.

features.name: Cloak of Shadows
features.effect: Become Invisible while obscured.

features.name: Shadow Step
features.effect: Bonus action teleport 18 m between obscured areas, then Advantage on your next melee attack roll.

features.name: Shadow Strike
features.effect: Action + 3 Ki, must be Invisible or Sneaking: teleport 9 m and melee attack, normal weapon (or unarmed) damage + 3d8 Psychic.

paladin.progression_notes: Subclass is chosen at level 1. channel_oath_charges is always 1, recharged on short or long rest (Channel Oath Charge page).

features.name: Divine Sense
features.effect: Bonus action (short rest): Advantage on attack rolls against celestials, fiends and undead until end of next turn.

features.name: Divine Smite
features.effect: On a melee weapon hit (action or free post-strike reaction, no reaction resource), expend a spell slot: +2d8 Radiant, +1d8 per slot level above 1st, capped at 5d8 (slots above 4th add nothing); +1d8 vs fiends or undead. Not a spell. Dice doubled on crit; slot not spent on miss.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.effect: One additional attack after an Action attack.

features.name: Aura of Protection
features.effect: You and nearby allies add your CHA modifier to saving throws.

features.name: Improved Divine Smite
features.effect: Melee weapon attacks deal an additional 1d8 Radiant (stacks with everything).

features.name: Holy Rebuke
features.effect: Channel Oath: target's melee attackers take 1d4 Radiant when they hit it (2 turns).

features.name: Sacred Weapon
features.effect: Action + Channel Oath, 10 turns: add CHA modifier to attack rolls with the weapon; weapon becomes magical.

features.name: Nature's Wrath
features.effect: Action + Channel Oath: STR save or Restrained 10 turns; attack rolls against it have Advantage.

features.name: Aura of Warding
features.effect: You and nearby allies take half damage from spells.

features.name: Righteous Clarity
features.effect: Bonus action + Channel Oath, 10 turns: you or an ally add proficiency bonus to attack rolls (again).

features.name: Champion Challenge
features.effect: Bonus action + Channel Oath, 9 m: WIS save or enemies have Disadvantage attacking anyone but you.

features.name: Divine Allegiance
features.effect: Reaction when an adjacent ally takes damage: heal them 2 x paladin level, take 2 x paladin level Radiant yourself.

features.name: Inquisitor's Might
features.effect: Bonus action + Channel Oath, 2 turns: you or an ally's weapon attacks deal + paladin's CHA modifier Radiant (minimum 1) and Daze for 1 turn (no save).

features.name: Vow of Enmity
features.effect: Bonus action + Channel Oath, 10 turns: Advantage on attack rolls against one enemy. Bug: can be cast on yourself for Advantage against all targets.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.effect: Hunter's Mark and Bane always prepared (Haste at 9).

features.name: Spiteful Suffering
features.effect: Action + Channel Oath, 3 turns: target takes 1d4 + CHA modifier Necrotic each turn and attack rolls against it have Advantage (CHA save, re-save each turn).

features.name: Aura of Hate
features.effect: You and fiends/undead within 3 m (including enemies) add your CHA modifier to melee weapon damage.

ranger.progression_notes: Ranger level 12 has 4 level-3 slots, which the wiki notes differs from 5e.

features.name: Favoured Enemy
features.effect: Choose at levels 1, 6 and 10. Damage relevant: Mage Breaker (True Strike cantrip), Sanctified Stalker (Sacred Flame cantrip), Bounty Hunter (targets hit by Ensnaring Strike have Disadvantage on the save).

features.name: Extra Attack
features.effect: One additional attack after an Action attack (wiki ranger page words it as attack twice with the Attack action).

features.name: Hide in Plain Sight
features.effect: Become Invisible with +10 Stealth while standing still.

features.name: Ranger's Companion
features.effect: Summon Bear, Boar, Dire Raven, Wolf or Wolf Spider companion (short rest). Companions have Prey's Scent: +1d6 Physical vs your Hunter's Mark target.

features.name: Companion's Bond
features.effect: Companion adds its proficiency bonus to AC and damage (bug: companion's own PB, and +2/+3 attack bump from bugged proficiency progression).

features.name: Bestial Fury
features.effect: Companions gain an extra attack.

features.name: Dread Ambusher
features.effect: +3 Initiative. First turn of each combat: +3 m movement and one extra free weapon attack (Dread Ambusher (Melee)/(Ranged) action) dealing +1d8 weapon damage.

features.name: Umbral Shroud
features.effect: Become Invisible while obscured (short rest).

features.name: Stalker's Flurry
features.effect: Once per turn, when you miss with a weapon attack, make another one for free.

features.name: Colossus Slayer
features.effect: Hunter's Prey option: once per turn a weapon attack deals +1d8 (Physical, DRS) if the target is below its HP maximum.

features.name: Horde Breaker (Melee)
features.effect: Hunter's Prey option: Action attack (triggers Extra Attack); marks creatures within 2 m of the target and grants one free follow-up attack against a marked creature. Once per turn.

features.name: Giant Killer
features.effect: Hunter's Prey option: reaction melee attack when a Large or bigger creature attacks you.

features.name: Volley
features.effect: Action: ranged weapon attack against every non-ally in a 3 m radius (can hit friendly NPCs).

features.name: Whirlwind Attack
features.effect: Action: melee weapon attack against every enemy within 2 m (separate attack rolls).

features.name: Gathered Swarm
features.effect: Once per round after you hit an enemy, the swarm can: deal 1d6 extra damage to the same target (Cloud of Jellyfish: Lightning, Flurry of Moths: Psychic, Legion of Bees: Piercing), or Shock/Blind/push 5 m, or teleport you. Faerie Fire and Mage Hand always prepared.

features.name: Prey's Scent (Swarmkeeper)
features.effect: Swarm damage option deals +1d6 (same type) against your Hunter's Mark target. Stays 1d6 after Mighty Swarm and is not doubled on crits.

features.name: Writhing Tide
features.effect: Fly 9 m, immune to surfaces (3 Writhing Currents, 4 at level 9).

features.name: Mighty Swarm
features.effect: Swarm attack damage becomes 1d8; utility option adds Prone/Disarm/Slow; teleport gives +2 AC for the round.

rogue.spellcasting_note: Arcane Trickster subclass is a one-third caster using Intelligence.

features.name: Sneak Attack (Melee)
features.effect: Once per round (refreshes after the rogue's turn, can be used on an enemy turn e.g. opportunity attack), with a finesse melee weapon or any ranged weapon: +1d6 weapon damage, +1d6 every 2 rogue levels (2d6 at 3, 3d6 at 5, 4d6 at 7, 5d6 at 9, 6d6 at 11). Requires Advantage, or an ally within 1.5 m of the target and no Disadvantage. Not usable with main-hand unarmed attacks; not applied to off-hand attack actions. Can be applied as a post-strike reaction (no reaction cost); dice doubled on crit.

features.name: Sneak Attack (Ranged)
features.effect: Ranged version, same dice and conditions.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.effect: Dash, Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.effect: Reaction: halve the damage of an attack that hits you.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.effect: One-third caster (Wizard list, mostly Enchantment/Illusion). Slots: L3 2x1st, L4 3x1st, L7 4x1st + 2x2nd, L10 6x1st + 2x2nd. Cantrips: Mage Hand + 2 (+3 from level 10).

features.name: Magical Ambush
features.effect: While Hiding, targets have Disadvantage on saves against your spells.

features.name: Assassinate: Initiative
features.effect: Advantage on attack rolls against creatures that haven't taken a turn yet in combat.

features.name: Assassinate: Ambush
features.effect: Any successful attack roll against a Surprised creature is a critical hit.

features.name: Assassin's Alacrity
features.effect: Restore your Action and Bonus Action at the start of combat (once per combat).

features.name: Rakish Sneak Attack (Melee)
features.effect: Replaces Sneak Attack (same dice: 2d6 at 3, 3d6 at 5, 4d6 at 7, 5d6 at 9, 6d6 at 11). Usable with Advantage, or without Advantage if no other combatants are within 1.5 m (tooltip says 2 m) of you/target, or with an adjacent ally; never with Disadvantage.

features.name: Rakish Audacity
features.effect: Initiative bonus +2 at rogue level 3, +3 at level 5, +4 later.
features.unverified_reason: Rakish Audacity page says +4 at rogue level 10, D&D 5e class changes page says +4 at level 9

features.name: Fancy Footwork
features.effect: A target you melee attack can't make opportunity attacks against you this turn.

features.name: Dirty Trick: Flick o' the Wrist
features.effect: Bonus action, finesse weapon: melee weapon attack, normal weapon damage, possible Disarm (DEX save vs CHA spell DC); on hit gain Dirty Advantage (Advantage on your next attack, 2 turns).

features.name: Dirty Trick: Sand Toss
features.effect: Bonus action: melee attack, 1d6 Bludgeoning, possible Blind (CON save vs DEX-based spell DC); on hit gain Dirty Advantage.

features.name: Dirty Trick: Vicious Mockery
features.effect: Bonus action cantrip: 1d4 Psychic (2d4 at character level 5, 3d4 at 10), WIS save, target Disadvantage on next attack; gain Dirty Advantage.

features.name: Panache
features.effect: Persuasion vs Insight: enemies get Panache: Disadvantage.

features.name: Fast Hands
features.effect: An extra Bonus Action every turn, usable for any bonus action (e.g. a second off-hand attack).

sorcerer.progression_notes: sorcery_points equal sorcerer level from level 2, long rest; the pool can exceed this by converting slots.

features.name: Create Spell Slot
features.effect: Sorcery Points to slot: 2 -> 1st, 3 -> 2nd, 5 -> 3rd, 6 -> 4th, 7 -> 5th. Create Sorcery Points: a slot gives points equal to its level.

features.name: Metamagic: Twinned Spell
features.effect: Single-target spell targets one more creature; 1 Sorcery Point per slot level (cantrips 1). Not for Eldritch Blast after level 5, Magic Missile, AoE spells (except Hail of Thorns, Lightning Arrow), Chain Lightning, summons, self spells.

features.name: Metamagic: Quickened Spell
features.effect: 3 Sorcery Points: a spell that costs an Action costs a Bonus Action instead.

features.name: Metamagic: Heightened Spell
features.effect: 3 Sorcery Points: targets have Disadvantage on their first save (all targets in BG3).

features.name: Metamagic choices
features.effect: 2 Metamagic at level 2 (Careful, Distant, Extended, Twinned available), +1 at level 3 (Heightened, Quickened, Subtle unlocked), +1 at level 10.

features.name: Draconic Ancestry
features.effect: Choose dragon colour: Black/Copper Acid, Blue/Bronze Lightning, Brass/Gold/Red Fire, Green Poison, Silver/White Cold; grants a bonus spell. Draconic Resilience: unarmoured AC 13, +1 HP per sorcerer level.

features.name: Elemental Affinity: Damage
features.effect: Spells dealing your ancestry's damage type add your CHA modifier to the damage.

features.name: Strength of the Grave
features.effect: On reaching 0 HP, regain 1 HP instead of being downed (automatic). Eyes of the Dark: 24 m darkvision.

features.name: Eyes of the Dark: Darkness
features.effect: Darkness for 2 Sorcery Points; you can see through all magical darkness.

features.name: Hound of Ill Omen
features.effect: Bonus action + 3 Sorcery Points (short rest): summon Nimbus (33 HP, AC 18) with Ominous Bite, Umbral Tangle, etc.

features.name: Shadow Walk
features.effect: Bonus action teleport 18 m to an obscured spot; next spell that turn gets free Distant Spell (stacks with other metamagic).

features.name: Tempestuous Magic
features.effect: After casting a level 1+ spell, fly 9 m as a bonus action without opportunity attacks.

features.name: Heart of the Storm
features.effect: Casting a level 1+ spell that deals Lightning or Thunder damage deals (sorcerer level / 2, rounded down) Lightning or Thunder to all enemies within 6 m. Also resistance to Lightning and Thunder. Bug: also triggers on cantrips.

features.name: Storm's Fury (passive feature)
features.effect: Reaction when hit by a melee attack: deal sorcerer level Lightning to the attacker and possibly push it.

features.name: Tides of Chaos
features.effect: 1 charge per short rest: Advantage on next attack roll, ability check or save; next levelled spell has 50% surge chance (normal 5%).

features.name: Wild Magic Surge
features.effect: 5% chance after level 1+ spells; e.g. Enchant Weapons (next attack of creatures within 6 m is a critical hit, +1d4 Force), Action Surge.

features.name: Bend Luck
features.effect: Reaction, 2 Sorcery Points: +/-1d4 to a creature's attack roll, check or save.

features.name: Controlled Chaos
features.effect: Reaction: trigger a Wild Magic surge on a nearby enemy spellcaster.

warlock.extra_attack_note: Pact of the Blade warlocks get an Extra Attack with the pact weapon at level 5 (Deepened Pact); outside Honour mode it stacks with other Extra Attack sources.
warlock.progression_notes: pact_slots are always cast at pact_slot_level and recharge on short rest. Mystic Arcanum: one 6th level spell once per long rest from level 11.

features.name: Eldritch Blast
features.effect: Cantrip: 1d10 Force per beam, spell attack, 18 m; 2 beams at character level 5, 3 at 10. Invocations and Hex apply per beam.

features.name: Agonising Blast
features.effect: Eldritch Invocation: add CHA modifier to Eldritch Blast damage (each beam), unless negative.

features.name: Repelling Blast
features.effect: Eldritch Invocation: Eldritch Blast pushes 4.5 m (once per cast).

features.name: Pact of the Blade
features.effect: Summon (battleaxe, glaive, greatsword, rapier, trident, warhammer; Hexblade also flail, maul, sickle) or bind a weapon: proficient, magical, uses CHA for attack and damage rolls (weapon action DC still STR/DEX).

features.name: Deepened Pact
features.effect: Blade: Extra Attack with the pact weapon (also Hexed weapon). Chain: familiar gains Extra Attack. Tome: Animate Dead, Haste, Call Lightning once per long rest.

features.name: Lifedrinker
features.effect: Eldritch Invocation (level 12): melee weapon attacks deal additional Necrotic damage equal to CHA modifier (DRS). Does not require Pact of the Blade in BG3.

features.name: Fey Presence
features.effect: Charm or Frighten nearby foes (short rest).

features.name: Dark One's Blessing
features.effect: Reducing a hostile creature to 0 HP gives CHA modifier + warlock level temp HP. Expanded spells: Burning Hands, Command, Scorching Ray, Fireball, etc.

features.name: Mortal Reminder
features.effect: On a critical hit, the creature and enemies within 3 m make a WIS save or are Frightened until end of their next turn.

features.name: Entropic Ward
features.effect: Reaction: impose Disadvantage on an attack against you; if it misses, Advantage on your next attack against the attacker.

features.name: Hex Warrior
features.effect: Medium armour, shields, martial weapons proficiency; Bind Hexed Weapon lets proficient weapon attacks use CHA (even if lower).

features.name: Bind Hexed Weapon
features.effect: Action: bind main-hand weapon, magical, uses CHA; on attack, fixed 20% chance (d20 >= 17, unmodified) to apply Hexblade's Curse to a target not already cursed.

features.name: Hexblade's Curse
features.effect: Bonus action, short rest, 10 turns: add your proficiency bonus to damage rolls against the target and your critical threshold against it is reduced by 1; heal warlock level + CHA modifier if it dies.

features.name: Accursed Spectre
features.effect: Once per long rest, raise a spectre from a creature slain while cursed (size determines Feeble/Mundane/Primordial spectre).

features.name: Armour of Hexes
features.effect: Attacks from your cursed target have a 50% chance to be nullified.

wizard.extra_attack_note: Bladesinging gains Extra Attack at wizard level 6 (cannot replace an attack with a cantrip).
wizard.progression_notes: arcane_recovery_charges = combined slot levels restorable once per day out of combat (no slots above 5th).

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.effect: Out of combat, once per day, recover expended spell slots totalling arcane_recovery_charges levels (max 5th level slots).

features.name: Arcane Ward
features.effect: Ward blocks damage equal to its intensity, then loses 1; starts at wizard level after long rest, +spell level per Abjuration spell, max 2x wizard level; +wizard level on short rest from level 10.

features.name: Training in War and Song
features.effect: Light armour, Performance, and Dagger, Longsword, Rapier, Scimitar, Shortsword, Sickle proficiency.

features.name: Bladesong
features.effect: Costs Bladesong Power (2 at level 2, 3 at 5, 4 at 9; long rest), 10 turns: +2 AC and +2 CON saves (+3 at 5, +4 at 9), +3 m movement, Advantage on Acrobatics. Requires main-hand dagger/longsword/rapier/scimitar/shortsword/sickle, no medium/heavy armour or shield. Casting level 1+ spells (not weapon attacks) builds Bladesong Damage Charges; weapon attacks build Healing Charges.

features.name: Bladesong Climax
features.effect: Bonus action + 3 m movement, ends Bladesong: jump 9 m, 1d6 Force + 1d6 per Damage Charge in 3 m radius, INT save for half; heals 1d6 + 1d6 per Healing Charge.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.effect: One additional attack after an Action attack.

features.name: Song of Defence
features.effect: While Bladesinging, expend a spell slot to reduce damage taken by 5 per slot level.

features.name: Focused Conjuration
features.effect: Damage doesn't break concentration on Conjuration spells.

features.name: Portent
features.effect: Two Portent dice after long rest (three from level 6); reaction to replace an attack roll or save near you.

features.name: Split Enchantment
features.effect: Single-target Enchantment spells can target 2 creatures.

features.name: Sculpt Spells
features.effect: Allies automatically succeed saves against your Evocation spells and take no damage.

features.name: Potent Cantrip
features.effect: Creatures that succeed on a save against your damaging cantrip take half damage (Acid Splash, Bursting Sinew, Poison Spray, Psychic Rend, Sacred Flame, Toll the Dead, Vicious Mockery).

features.name: Empowered Evocation
features.effect: Add INT modifier to damage rolls of all Evocation spells, including each Magic Missile dart, each Scorching Ray, each Eldritch Blast beam and Evocation cantrips such as Fire Bolt.

features.name: Illusory Self
features.effect: Make an attack against you miss.

features.name: Grim Harvest
features.effect: Once per turn, killing a creature with a spell heals 2 x slot level (3 x for Necromancy).

features.name: Undead Thralls: Better Summons
features.effect: Animate Dead creatures get + wizard level HP and add your proficiency bonus to damage (and use it for attack rolls); raise an additional corpse.

features.name: Transmuter's Stone
features.effect: Create a stone granting CON save proficiency, darkvision, speed or an elemental resistance.

Archery.effect: +2 bonus to attack rolls with ranged weapons.

Defence.effect: +1 bonus to Armour Class while wearing armour.

Duelling.effect: Wielding a melee weapon that is not Two-Handed in one hand and no weapon in the other: +2 damage with that weapon. A shield in the free hand still allows the bonus.

Great Weapon Fighting.effect: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack with a Two-Handed melee weapon (also Versatile with empty off-hand), that die is rerolled once. Unlike 5e, added damage dice (Superiority Die, Divine Smite, coatings) are also rerolled.

Protection.effect: With a shield, use a reaction to impose Disadvantage on an enemy attacking an ally within 1.5 m (5 ft).

Two-Weapon Fighting.effect: Add your ability score modifier to the damage of off-hand attacks. Gives no benefit to thrown weapons (BG3 already adds the modifier to throws).

Relentless Endurance: drop to 1 HP instead of downed, once per long rest

Draconic Ancestry: Resistance to Acid

races._note: Every race gets +2 to one ability and +1 to another, freely assigned (Races page). Racial spells are once per long rest unless noted.

Ability Improvement.effect: +2 to one ability score or +1 to two, max 20.

Actor.effect: +1 CHA (max 20); expertise in Deception and Performance.

Athlete.effect: +1 STR or DEX (max 20); standing up from Prone uses much less movement; jump distance +50%.

Charger.effect: Charger: Weapon Attack (Action + Bonus Action): charge up to 9 m without provoking opportunity attacks and make a melee weapon attack dealing normal weapon damage + 5 to the first creature in the path; benefits from Extra Attack. Charger: Shove variant.

Crossbow Expert.effect: Point-Blank: crossbow attacks in melee range have no Disadvantage (only helps with a single adjacent enemy). Wounding: Piercing Shot's Gaping Wounds last twice as long. No bonus-action hand crossbow attack in BG3.

Defensive Duellist.effect: Reaction when hit in melee with a proficient finesse weapon: + proficiency bonus to AC. (Feats table: requires DEX 13; 5e changes page says the prerequisite is ignored.)

Dual Wielder.effect: Two-Weapon Fighting with non-Light one-handed weapons (not Two-Handed); +1 AC while wielding a melee weapon in each hand. Does not add the ability modifier to off-hand damage (that needs the Two-Weapon Fighting style).

Dungeon Delver.effect: Advantage on Perception to find hidden objects; resistance to trap damage.

Durable.effect: +1 CON (max 20); regain full HP on short rest.

Elemental Adept.effect: Choose Acid, Cold, Lightning, Fire or Thunder: your spells and attacks ignore resistance to that type, and damage dice of that type from spells can't roll a 1 (1 counts as 2; bug: also non-spell attacks of that type such as breath weapons). No spellcaster requirement.

Great Weapon Master.effect: Bonus Attack: after a melee weapon critical hit or kill, make a melee weapon attack as a Bonus Action that turn (any melee weapon; can trigger multiple times per turn but not from itself). All In (toggle): with a proficient melee weapon held in both hands (Two-Handed or Versatile), -5 to attack rolls and +10 damage.

Heavily Armoured.effect: +1 STR (max 20); Heavy Armour proficiency. Requires Medium Armour proficiency.

Heavy Armour Master.effect: +1 STR (max 20); while wearing heavy armour incoming non-magical damage reduced by 3 (bug: all physical damage). Requires Heavy Armour proficiency.

Lightly Armoured.effect: +1 STR or DEX (max 20); Light Armour proficiency.

Lucky.effect: 3 Luck Points per long rest: spend one to gain Advantage on your next ability check, or (reaction) Advantage on an attack roll or saving throw, or make an enemy reroll its attack roll. Advantage is gained before the roll, so it enables Sneak Attack.

Mage Slayer.effect: Advantage on saves vs spells cast within melee range; reaction attack against a creature casting a spell within 1.5 m (2 m in practice); enemies you hit have Disadvantage on concentration saves.

Magic Initiate: Bard.effect: 2 Bard cantrips and a 1st-level Bard spell (once per long rest), Charisma.

Magic Initiate: Cleric.effect: 2 Cleric cantrips and a 1st-level Cleric spell (once per long rest), Wisdom. Bug: medium armour DEX cap +3.

Magic Initiate: Druid.effect: 2 Druid cantrips and a 1st-level Druid spell (once per long rest), Wisdom.

Magic Initiate: Sorcerer.effect: 2 Sorcerer cantrips and a 1st-level Sorcerer spell (once per long rest), Charisma.

Magic Initiate: Warlock.effect: 2 Warlock cantrips (e.g. Eldritch Blast) and a 1st-level Warlock spell (e.g. Hex, once per long rest), Charisma.

Magic Initiate: Wizard.effect: 2 Wizard cantrips and a 1st-level Wizard spell (once per long rest), Intelligence.

Martial Adept.effect: Learn two Battle Master manoeuvres and gain 1 (additional) Superiority Die, recharge short or long rest.
Martial Adept.unverified_parts: die size for non-Battle Masters not stated on the pages read (presumably d8)

Medium Armour Master.effect: No Stealth Disadvantage in medium armour; DEX AC cap +3 in medium armour.

Mobile.effect: +3 m movement; Dash ignores difficult terrain; no opportunity attack from a creature you made a melee attack against.

Moderately Armoured.effect: +1 STR or DEX (max 20); Medium Armour and Shields proficiency. Requires Light Armour proficiency.

Polearm Master.effect: Bonus Attack: after attacking with a glaive, halberd, pike, quarterstaff or spear, bonus action butt attack for 1d4 + STR or DEX (higher) Bludgeoning, once per turn, only in turn-based mode. Opportunity Attack when a creature enters your reach.

Resilient.effect: +1 to an ability (max 20) and proficiency in its saving throws.

Ritual Caster.effect: Learn two of: Speak with Dead, Find Familiar, Longstrider, Enhance Leap, Disguise Self, Speak with Animals.

Savage Attacker.effect: Melee weapon attacks roll damage dice twice and use the higher (each die independently; not limited to once per turn). Also applies to damage riders such as Divine Smite and, since Patch 7, Sneak Attack, Blade Flourishes and Manoeuvres. Great Weapon Fighting rerolls are applied first.

Sentinel.effect: Reaction weapon attack when an enemy in melee range attacks an ally (not one with Sentinel); creatures hit by your opportunity attack can't move; Advantage on opportunity attacks.

Sharpshooter.effect: All In (toggle): ranged weapon attacks with proficient weapons -5 to hit, +10 damage (outside Honour mode added to every damage instance of the attack). Low Ground: no high-ground penalty on ranged weapon attacks.

Shield Master.effect: +2 DEX saves with a shield; reaction to reduce DEX-save spell damage.

Spell Sniper.effect: Learn a cantrip (Bone Chill, Eldritch Blast, Fire Bolt, Ray of Frost, Shocking Grasp or Thorn Whip, using your spellcasting ability); critical threshold of spell attack rolls reduced by 1 (stacks). Not for weapon-attack spells like Booming Blade.

Tavern Brawler.effect: +1 STR or CON (max 20). Unarmed attacks, improvised weapons and throws add your Strength modifier an additional time to attack and damage rolls (always STR, even for DEX-based unarmed strikes). Applies in Wild Shape (not Fire/Water/Air Myrmidon). Honour mode: improvised melee attacks get the attack bonus but not the extra damage.

War Caster.effect: Advantage on concentration saves; reaction Shocking Grasp at a creature leaving melee range.

Weapon Master.effect: +1 STR or DEX (max 20); proficiency with four weapon types.

feats._note: All classes pick a feat at class levels 4, 8 and 12; Fighters also at 6 and Rogues at 10 (Feats page). Feat ability increases are capped at 20.

point_buy.costs_note: Derived from the stated rule: each increase up to 13 costs 1 point, 14 and 15 cost 2 points each.
point_buy.background_bonus: +2 to one ability score and +1 to a different ability score, freely assigned at character creation (not tied to race or background; the Races page lists it as the racial bonus). Max starting score 17.

notes.note: Patch 8 (15 April 2025, final major patch; latest hotfix listed is Hotfix 36) added exactly one subclass per class: Giant (Path of Giants) barbarian, College of Glamour, Death Domain, Circle of the Stars, Arcane Archer, Way of the Drunken Master, Oath of the Crown, Swarmkeeper, Swashbuckler, Shadow Magic, The Hexblade, Bladesinging. It also added Booming Blade, Bursting Sinew, Shadow Blade, Staggering Smite and Toll the Dead.
Level cap 12. Proficiency bonus follows character level (+2 at 1-4, +3 at 5-8, +4 at 9-12), not class level.
Initiative is d4 + DEX in BG3, so flat initiative bonuses (Alert +5, Feral Instinct +3, Dread Ambusher +3, Rakish Audacity) are much stronger than in 5e.

Extra Attack sources do not stack, except Warlock Pact of the Blade's Deepened Pact outside Honour mode. Extra Attack only triggers from attacks that cost an Action; extra actions from Haste/Elixir of Bloodlust also allow it outside Honour mode (only Action Surge in Honour mode).

Critical hits double all damage dice (including smites, sneak attack, manoeuvres), not flat modifiers. Critical threshold reductions stack (Champion, Hexblade's Curse, Spell Sniper for spells). Paralysed/Sleeping targets and Hold Person/Hold Monster give guaranteed crits on melee-range attacks.
Sneak Attack is once per round (not once per turn), refreshing after the rogue's turn, and is never applied to Off-Hand Attack actions.
Divine Smite is not a spell, can be triggered as a free post-strike reaction (no reaction cost) on any melee weapon hit, damage caps at 5d8 (+1d8 vs undead/fiends).
Rage damage in BG3 applies to finesse/Dexterity melee attacks, unarmed strikes and throws as well as STR melee.
Monk: Ki = monk level + 1 (2 at level 1), Martial Arts die 1d4 (1-2), 1d6 (3-8), 1d8 (9-12); most ki abilities use the better of STR/DEX for DCs (Four Elements uses WIS).
Paladin subclass chosen at level 1, with a single Channel Oath charge that recharges on short rest (never increases).
Arcane Trickster has 6 level-1 slots from rogue level 10; Ranger 12 has 4 level-3 slots. Both differ from 5e.

Hunter's Mark (ranger level 2, Vengeance oath spell): bonus action + level 1 slot, concentration, +1d6 weapon damage per weapon hit; upcasting gives nothing; does not apply to unarmed attacks in BG3. Hex (warlock): +1d6 Necrotic per attack-roll hit, including each Eldritch Blast beam.
Great Weapon Fighting in BG3 rerolls 1s and 2s on all damage dice of the attack (smites, superiority dice, coatings), unlike 5e. Savage Attacker also rerolls rider dice and is not once per turn.
Tavern Brawler adds STR to both attack and damage of unarmed/improvised/thrown attacks; the wiki calls it one of the strongest feats. Its throw damage has no damage type and can't be resisted (bug).
Warlock Lifedrinker (level 12) needs no Pact of the Blade; Pact weapons and Hexed weapons use CHA for attack and damage.
Bladesong adds a flat +2/+3/+4 (levels 2/5/9) to AC and CON saves instead of the INT modifier, and adds Bladesong Climax (Force damage scaling with spells cast).

Wiki inconsistencies found: Swarmkeeper upgraded swarm table still shows 1d6 while Mighty Swarm and Cloud of Jellyfish: Attack pages say 1d8 (1d8 used). Sphere of Elemental Balance is 3d8 on Elemental Disciplines but 2d8 (non-thunder) on the Ki Point page. Rakish Audacity +4 initiative at rogue level 10 (feature page) vs 9 (5e changes page). Feats table says Defensive Duellist needs DEX 13, 5e changes says the prerequisite is ignored.

Several Honour-mode-only differences exist (DRS/damage-rider rules): e.g. Sharpshooter's +10 applies to each damage instance only outside Honour mode, Sobering Realisation deals 1d8 instead of 2d8 in Honour mode, Savage Attacks' second extra die on smites/sneak attack is disabled in Honour mode.

Not captured (would need more pages): companion/summon stat blocks (Beast Master companions, Nimbus, Accursed Spectres, Animate Dead), Wild Shape form attacks, spell damage tables, weapon tables (repo already has items).
